info.title: RECAVO API
info.description: REST JSON API under `/api/v1` (OpenAPI 3.1). Generated from the live Fastify route table plus curated overlays (`npm run openapi:export`). Conventions — cursor pagination, filter allow-lists, problem+json errors, and `x-request-id` on every response — are documented in `documents/api-conventions.md`. Human index: `/docs`.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase access token (or legacy session cookie on browser clients).

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page `nextCursor`. Do not parse or construct client-side. Omit on the first page; do not reuse across different filter sets.

X-Request-Id.description: Correlation / request id (UUIDv7). Echoes an inbound x-request-id when provided; otherwise generated. Matches problem+json `requestId` on errors.

field.description: Dotted path, header name, or `(body)` for body-level problems

message.description: Optional human-readable fallback for clients without a localisation map

type.description: Documentation URI for this problem class

title.description: Short, stable summary suitable for assistive announcements

detail.description: Optional actionable explanation (never present for INTERNAL)

requestId.description: Correlation id; matches the x-request-id response header

errors.description: Field-level validation problems (empty for non-validation errors)

NextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when the list is exhausted. Pass as `cursor` on the subsequent request.

includesRefundedRevenue.description: When false, refunds are excluded from net and tracked as refundedMinor.

includesDisputedRevenue.description: When false, open disputes/chargebacks are excluded from net and tracked as disputedMinor (RECA-439).

lineItems.description: Every service on this booking, `position`-ordered (RECA-516). Always non-empty: item 0 is the primary service and matches `serviceSnapshot`. `priceMinor` and `end` are the roll-up across all items — render this list as the job checklist and do not recompute totals from the primary service alone.

allDay.description: Staff marked this an all-day job (RECA-532): start/end are local midnights at the location (end exclusive). Show the date(s) and "All day" rather than times.

linkedRecordId.description: Linked record (vehicle/pet/etc.) for this booking (RECA-90). Required when the service has `requiresLinkedRecord` or the active definition has `settings.requireForBooking`. Soft-archiving the record never clears this id — historical bookings remain readable via GET …/linked-records/{recordId}.

attendees.description: Booking attendees (RECA-111). lead_pays_party requires exactly two: one lead customer and one guest name with customerId null (guest is not a portal customer).

depositMinor.description: Deposit securing the booking (RECA-523), snapshotted at create from the services’ configured deposits or a staff override. Null = no deposit: the booking is paid in full up front. Only ever set strictly between 0 and priceMinor.

paidMinor.description: Money received to date across every channel — card, bank transfer, cash recorded by staff (RECA-523). Outstanding balance = priceMinor - paidMinor.

applicablePolicyDocumentIds.description: Map of policy type → policy_documents.id effective at booking create (RECA-67). At least `cancellation` is set when a published cancellation policy exists.

slotToken.description: HMAC-signed, expiring quote token; revalidated on hold/book.

nickname.description: Staff-facing "known as" name, e.g. "Dave – red Audi" (RECA-528). Never shown to the customer.

avatarFileId.description: Profile picture (RECA-530): a file uploaded via POST /files with ownerType `customer` and ownerId = this customer. Resolve to an image with GET /files/{id}/url.

preferredChannel.description: Preferred contact channel. `sms` opts the customer into SMS job reminders (RECA-518) — delivered only while the business holds the reminders.sms entitlement and the customer keeps operational notifications on; otherwise reminders fall back to email.

tags.description: Legacy denormalised string tags on create/update. Prefer customer-tags catalogue + assignments (RECA-78) for segmentation/filter.

BusinessOnboarding.description: Setup checklist progress. Required-step completion is derived from live entities; only dismiss and optional skip are persisted. Distinct from Business.onboardingState (template lifecycle).

href.description: Portal path for the step deep-link

version.description: Checklist definition version; bump when the step set changes

href.description: Portal path for the step deep-link

requireForBooking.description: When true, booking create rejects a missing linkedRecordId even if the service does not set requiresLinkedRecord (RECA-90).

status.description: Soft-archive only. Archived records stay readable for booking history and keep booking.linkedRecordId intact (RECA-90).

endedAt.description: `null` = current owner (at most one open interval per record).

assignedBy.description: Actor who created the interval: record creator or transferring staff user.

CalendarBlock.description: Personal time on a staff diary (dentist, school run). Occupies the staff member exactly like a booking — the two can never overlap — but carries no customer, service or payment. Render in `colour`; `kind` distinguishes it from a Booking in a merged calendar feed.

locationId.description: Site the block applies to; null = the whole diary.

colour.description: Upper-case #RRGGBB; defaults to slate grey (#64748B) when omitted on create.

depositMinor.description: Deposit collected up front to secure a booking of this service (RECA-523, supersedes the RECA-467 / ADR 0018 offline-only deferral). Minor units; 0/null = no deposit. Summed across a multi-service job and snapshotted onto the booking at create.

items.description: Recurring local window when this session type may be booked. Empty availabilityWindows means unrestricted (staff working rules ∩ location hours still apply).

requiresLinkedRecord.description: When true, booking create requires an active linkedRecordId for the lead customer (OR with definition settings.requireForBooking; RECA-90).

packageId.description: Sellable package for package-checkout payments; null for booking payments.

taxTreatment.description: Tax treatment snapshotted at purchase (RECA-142 / ADR 0017; VAT registration only)

documentKind.description: Connect customer documents are receipts only at launch (ADR 0017)

objectKey.description: Non-guessable business-prefixed object storage key (never log file bytes).

checksum.description: SHA-256 hex digest registered on upload complete (RECA-82).

ownerType.description: Optional provenance for ACL hooks (RECA-83): customer|booking|linked_record|business.

deletedAt.description: Set when status=deleted after retention soft-delete (RECA-83).

BusinessSummary.description: Business the authenticated user has an active membership in.

BusinessConfiguration.description: Business settings: terminology, booking, tax, retention, legal address and branding.

vatRateBps.description: VAT rate in basis points (2000 = 20%). Drives the per-line VAT breakdown on invoices when vatRegistered; null = no VAT breakdown (ADR 0019).

pricesIncludeVat.description: Whether service prices already include VAT (UK consumer default true). Exclusive pricing adds VAT on top of the line total.

invoicing.description: Customer invoicing preferences (ADR 0019). Invoicing itself is the `invoicing` feature (included in Growth, paid bolt-on below); these settings apply once entitled.

autoSendOnCompletion.description: Issue and email a PDF invoice automatically when a job is marked attended/completed.

numberPrefix.description: Prefix for sequential invoice numbers, e.g. `INV-` → INV-0001.

branding.description: Customer-facing email branding; null fields fall back to platform branding.

logoUrl.description: Absolute https URL to a logo image.

accentColour.description: Hex accent used for buttons and rules in email.

bankTransfer.description: Pay-by-bank account details (RECA-522). `enabled: true` requires accountName, sortCode and accountNumber; IBAN/BIC are optional for international clients. Shown to paying customers with the booking reference; staff confirm receipt manually via the bank-transfer-received endpoint.

reminders.description: Automatic booking reminders (RECA-530). On PATCH the whole `rules` array is replaced; `[]` turns reminders off. Up to 5 rules, each 5 minutes to 30 days before the booking, offsets unique. `channel: sms` requires the reminders.sms entitlement (Business/Growth, or the Solo bolt-on) — otherwise 403. Changing rules rebuilds the open reminders for upcoming bookings without resending any already sent. Default: 24h and 1h before, client preference.

channel.description: `preferred` follows the client’s contact preference (SMS only when they opted in and the business is entitled); `email` always emails; `sms` texts when the client has a phone and has not opted out of operational messages, else email.

reference.description: Booking reference (B-XXXXXXXX) the customer must quote as the payment reference.

amountMinor.description: What is due *now* (RECA-523): the deposit remainder while the booking is being secured, otherwise the outstanding balance — never blindly the full price.

locationScopeIds.description: null = access to all locations; otherwise the restricted set.

eligibleServiceIds.description: Empty = credits usable on all services.

CreditBalance.description: Balance derived from the append-only credit ledger. `available` is spendable.

number.description: Sequential per-business number (prefix + zero-padded), assigned on issue.

unitPriceMinor.description: Per unit as entered — gross when pricesIncludeVat, net otherwise.

paymentInstructions.description: Bank transfer details printed when enabled and a balance is due.
